description: This file defines the routes for post-related API endpoints in a Node.js Express application, including operations like creating, deleting, retrieving, searching posts, and commenting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new post.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a specific post by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its ID.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Lists posts created by a specific user.

methods.name: explore
methods.description: Provides an exploration view of posts.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches posts based on query parameters.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific post.
